pass_condition: At least 10 mutants across writer, migrations and reader are killed by the packet's own tests.

findings.statement: Four of fourteen mutants survive the packet's suite: a rank written onto a not-ranked row, non-canonical JSON, a deleted transaction commit, and an unconditional v1 rename.
findings.failure_scenario: M3 sets rank=1 on gated and unrated rows and all 43 tests pass, although 06 section 4 says gated/unrated rows carry no rank; M4 (sort_keys=False), M5 (no conn.commit()) and M10 (rename without the v1-shape check) likewise pass unnoticed.

observations: Killed 9/14: M1 dropped column, M2 leverage/friction swap, M6 measured constant, M7 p_/c_ swap, M8 snapshot_id guard, M9 version bump, M11 NULLS LAST at the friction level, M12 a removed ORDER BY level, M13 list_not_ranked's unrated branch.
M14 (ROW_NUMBER -> RANK) is an equivalent mutant, argued in the reader parity record.
__pycache__ cleared before every run; the tree restored byte-identical after each mutant (git diff --stat empty).

not_checked.statement: W4-3's persona re-projection SQL and W4-4's endpoints are not in this packet; only the reader helpers they build on were checked.
